title: search-tidy — three loose ends the search build left outside its fence (Sonnet)

set.request: three loose ends the search build left outside its fence: rewrite /imagine/platform/omnibox/page.js, fix core/page.js's count sentence, contain the four sandbox CSS/JS leaks and shrink Search's skip list
steps: contain alex's two unlayered CSS files
move arya body-class add into initialize()
shrink core/Search skip list, prove corpus rose
scope the omnibox to core/Search/page.js only (owner course-correction)
update platform/omnibox page + Search readme for the scoped box
set.outcome:
**Three loose ends closed, plus one mid-task course correction from the owner.**

![](shot.png)

- [`/imagine/platform/omnibox/`](/imagine/platform/omnibox/) rewritten as a pointer: what the Omnibox is now, a link to `core/Search`, and the platform research it started as. The dead prototype wiring (its own `Omnibox` import, the "indexing…" stat) is gone.
- `core/page.js`'s count sentence fixed by actually reading the dir (9 children now, not 7): **five** are an element you can point at — View, Page, App, Sidebar, and Layout (it extends Page) — **four** are not (Router, Item, List, Search).
- The four named sandbox leaks contained, none of their own work restyled: `castin/main.css`'s two undeclared layers and `alex`'s/`edric`'s unlayered sheets now sort inside the framework's own declared `@layer base`; `arya/lib/Page.js`'s body-class add moved out of module scope into a real `initialize()`, called only when a page of its actually renders. Proven: `Search.check()` reports nothing and `/framework/`'s computed styles are byte-identical before/after importing each, headless.
- `/arya/` came out of `Search.prototype.skip` (+12 candidates tried, +0 rows — arya's own hand-rolled `Page` class never satisfies `instanceof`, an unrelated fact). `/alex/`, `/castin/`, `/edric/` **stay skipped**: proving the above surfaced a SEPARATE bug in each — `alex/page.js`, `edric/page.js` and six files under `castin/` add the site's real `theme-1` class at module scope too, same shape as arya's bug but in files outside this task's fence. Named in `Search.js`'s own skip comment for whoever picks it up.
- **Course correction mid-task (the owner):** the omnibox was breaking other pages by living site-wide, so it moved onto [`core/Search`](/framework/core/Search/)'s own page — `app.js`'s two lines reverted, `activated()`/`deactivated()` there mount and tear the box down. Proven headless: no `.omnibox` anywhere else and `/` does nothing there; present and working only on the Search page and its own doc tabs, gone the moment you leave.

**Left, named, not fixed:**
- The `theme-1`-at-module-scope bug above (three sandboxes, several files each) — fixing it lets those skip lines go too.
- `core/readme.md`'s own "seven classes" line is also stale (Search and Layout both landed); one sentence, different file, outside this fence.
- `ext/Omnibox/Omnibox.js`'s pointer shim has no importers left after this task; its own doc page still describes itself as live.
- Pre-existing and unrelated: `/arya/` (real nav, not just a raw import) falls back to the homepage instead of its own content — Search's corpus walk reaches it by import, the site's Router does not. Not touched.
